abstract: Design and validation of visual icon-based health literacy posters and touchscreen displays for rural elderly patients managing hypertension and diabetes.
problem_statement: High elderly population in Meenachil taluk faces low medication adherence due to dense text-heavy medical prescriptions and leaflets.
objectives:
1. Audit readability of current PHC signage.
2. Design intuitive visual pictogram dosage system.
3. Test comprehension with 100 seniors.
methodology: Participatory design workshops with ASHA workers followed by visual usability testing.
keywords: Health Communication, Information Design, Geriatric Healthcare, Pictograms, Usability
expected_results: Validated multilingual pictorial prescription card improving dosage accuracy by 35%.

title: Deep Convolutional Vision Network for Multi-Class Foliar Disease Detection in Rubber Trees
programme: Integrated M.Sc. Programme in Computer Science – Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
abstract: A deep transfer learning model using EfficientNet-B4 to classify Corynespora and Colletotrichum leaf fall diseases from smartphone leaf imagery under field illumination.
problem_statement: Early stage rubber leaf disease identification requires lab microscopic confirmation, causing catastrophic plantation defoliation during monsoon.
objectives:
1. Curate a benchmark dataset of 3,000 localized rubber leaf disease images.
2. Fine-tune lightweight CNN architecture for offline mobile deployment.
3. Achieve >92% classification accuracy.
methodology: Transfer learning on EfficientNet with test-time augmentation and INT8 model quantization for Android execution.
keywords: Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Foliar Disease, Rubber Plantation, Transfer Learning
expected_results: A sub-15MB mobile model delivering 93.4% accuracy under diverse natural lighting.

title: Impact of Digital GST E-Invoicing on Working Capital Flow in Spice and Plantation Export Houses
abstract: Analysis of input tax credit refund cycles and liquidity bottlenecks faced by cardamom and pepper exporters after mandatory GST e-invoice portal integration.
problem_statement: Exporters face delayed input tax credit realization, tying up 18-24% of liquid working capital in seasonal procurement periods.
objectives:
1. Quantify working capital cycle changes before and after e-invoicing.
2. Identify credit reconciliation friction points.
3. Formulate institutional cash-flow recommendations.
methodology: Financial ratio analysis of 25 registered spice exporters in Kottayam and Idukki spanning 2022-2026.
keywords: GST, E-Invoicing, Working Capital, Spice Exports, Input Tax Credit
expected_results: Evidence-based policy brief detailing cash conversion cycle improvements.

title: Live Memory Volatility Analysis and Forensic Artifact Extraction on Encrypted Mobile Messaging Apps
abstract: Extraction and timeline reconstruction of ephemeral encrypted chat memory artifacts from physical Android RAM dumps prior to encryption key destruction.
problem_statement: Modern messaging applications utilize end-to-end encryption with ephemeral self-deleting messages, hindering lawful criminal digital investigations.
objectives:
1. Capture cold-boot RAM dumps on Android devices running modern Linux kernels.
2. Reconstruct decrypted message buffers from unallocated memory pools.
3. Develop open-source Volatility forensics plugin.
methodology: Custom LiME kernel module memory acquisition and Volatility profile parsing in controlled sandbox.
keywords: Digital Forensics, Memory Analysis, Volatility, Ephemeral Messaging, Mobile Security
expected_results: A specialized Volatility parser extracting up to 70% of transient message buffers before garbage collection.

title: Psychosocial Adjustment and Community Support Needs of Left-Behind Elderly in Emigrant Rural Households
abstract: An assessment of depressive symptoms, social isolation, and emergency health vulnerabilities among senior citizens in Cherpunkal whose adult children have migrated overseas.
problem_statement: Out-migration of youth to UK, Canada, and Gulf countries has created empty-nest households where solitary elderly face chronic loneliness and emergency vulnerabilities.
objectives:
1. Administer Geriatric Depression Scale (GDS-15) across 120 households.
2. Evaluate village neighborhood care circles.
3. Design community volunteer intervention protocol.
methodology: Cross-sectional study across 120 households in Kidangoor and Cherpunkal panchayats with qualitative in-depth case interviews.
keywords: Social Work, Geriatric Mental Health, Emigration, Community Care, Kudumbashree
expected_results: Comprehensive psychosocial vulnerability matrix and actionable community volunteer protocol.

title: Real-Time Unreal Engine 3D Heritage Reconstruction and Virtual Tour of Cherpunkal Historic Sites
department: Department of Animation and Visual Effects
abstract: High-fidelity 3D digital preservation and real-time interactive walkthrough of the historical Cherpunkal Church architecture and old Meenachil wooden boat landing sites.
problem_statement: Ancient timber architecture and stone carvings are deteriorating without accurate millimeter-level 3D spatial recording.
objectives:
1. Capture photogrammetric point clouds of target heritage structures.
2. Optimize low-poly LOD geometry with 4K PBR texturing.
3. Deploy interactive VR experience in Unreal Engine 5.
methodology: Drone LiDAR and DSLR photogrammetry processed via RealityCapture, modeled in Blender, and lit with Lumen in UE5.
keywords: 3D Heritage Preservation, Photogrammetry, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality, Digital Archival
expected_results: A fully interactive 60fps real-time virtual museum tour accessible via web and VR headsets.

title: Development and Glycemic Profiling of Functional Extruded Snacks from Jackfruit Flour and Defatted Coconut Meal
department: Department of Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics
abstract: Formulation, sensory profiling, and in vitro starch hydrolysis rate of a low-cost high-fiber extruded snack using mature green jackfruit seed flour and agro-waste coconut meal.
problem_statement: Rising diabetes prevalence in Kerala requires accessible low-glycemic dietary alternatives utilizing indigenous underutilized crops.
objectives:
1. Optimize extrusion parameters for jackfruit-coconut composite flour blends.
2. Analyze proximate composition, dietary fiber, and antioxidant capacity.
3. Determine estimated glycemic index (eGI).
methodology: Twin-screw extrusion trial, 9-point hedonic sensory evaluation, and in vitro enzymatic starch digestion testing.
keywords: Clinical Nutrition, Jackfruit Flour, Glycemic Index, Dietary Fiber, Functional Foods
expected_results: Low-glycemic extruded snack (eGI < 55) with 14% protein and 18% dietary fiber content.
